spec.name: Bauhaus Songbird
spec.description: A stylized songbird built from pure Bauhaus geometry — red egg body, blue ball head, yellow triangle beak and a black fan tail — perched on an ink-black branch dotted with primary-coloured circle leaves.
spec.layout: The model reads as a bold flat-coloured sculpture on a gallery plinth of branch. From the front (+Z) the viewer sees the bird face on: a cream breast bib on a red egg-shaped torso, a blue ball head above it with two big round black-and-white eye discs set wide, and a single yellow triangle beak dead centre — nothing covers the face. The branch runs horizontally left-right along X, resting on the floor, with the bird perched at its centre: yellow legs drop straight from the body underside and black toes grip the branch top. The tail is a black quarter-circle fan sweeping down-back to about z = -0.5, tipped with a yellow wedge; folded wings hug each flank as stacked geometric slabs (blue half-disc over a red crescent over a black tip triangle), keeping the silhouette clean. The Bauhaus style shows everywhere: every piece is a primitive (spheres, cones, discs, fans), each wears one flat colour from the primary palette plus black and cream, and details are crisp geometric overlays — ring collars, circle emblems, wedge stripes — never soft blends. The branch itself is matte black with stubby twigs ending in flat primary-coloured circle and half-circle leaves.

parts.builds: The branch the bird stands on: a gently dipping tapered tube swept along X from x = -0.75 to x = 0.75, sagging a few centimetres at mid-span, radius about 0.09 at the centre tapering to 0.05 at the ends, flat cap discs at both cut ends, all in ink black. Two stub twigs sprout from the underside and sides (one near x = -0.4 angling down-forward, one near x = 0.45 angling up-back), each ending in flat geometric foliage: full disc leaves and half-disc leaves as thin extruded circles in bauhausRed, bauhausBlue, bauhausYellow and cream, three to five per twig tip, slightly fanned. A short secondary twig near x = -0.15 carries a single large cream half-disc. All leaves are thin (about 8 mm) flat primitives with hard edges; nothing soft or organic. The branch top at the perch point stays clear and flat-ish so the toes read as gripping it.
parts.attaches: Stands alone on the floor; the legs part grips its top at mount perchTop [0, 0.18, 0]. Its lowest point (the sagging mid-span underside and twig tips that dip) touches y = 0.

parts.builds: Two bird legs in pure cylinders: each a straight bauhausYellow rod, radius 0.02, dropping from its hip joint (legL at x = +0.055, legR at x = -0.055, y = 0.36) down to the branch top at y = 0.18, with a small ink-black band cuff (a short wider cylinder ring) around each leg just above the foot. Each foot is built in ink black: three forward toes as short bent rod segments spreading over the branch's front-top surface, one rear toe wrapping the back, each tipped with a tiny black claw cone; toes press slightly into the branch top so they read as gripping. A small cream ring (thin torus or short cylinder) sits at the very top of each leg where it meets the body, as a feather-cuff trim.
parts.attaches: Upper ends meet the body underside at mount hipCenter [0, 0.36, 0] (joints legL, legR); feet land on the branch at mount perchTop [0, 0.18, 0].

parts.builds: The torso and tail. The torso is a smooth loft from the tail root up to the neck: an egg form about 0.34 long and 0.30 tall, widest just behind the wings, wearing bauhausRed overall. On the front of the chest sits a cream breast bib: a large overlapping half-disc shell or curved inset panel covering the lower front half of the egg from below the beak line down to the belly, edged with a thin ink-black rim piece so the zigzag-free hard edge reads crisp. A small white circle emblem (a thin flat disc, 4 cm) is seated on the left flank as a Bauhaus stamp. The tail leaves the body low at the back through a bauhausBlue ring collar (a short fat cylinder around the tail root) and sweeps down-back as a bold black quarter-circle fan: a flat extruded slab about 3 cm thick, 0.28 long and 0.26 wide at its widest, its outer arc carrying a bauhausYellow wedge stripe (a second smaller fan slab layered on the fan's underside tip). Tail root joint tailBase aims down-back.
parts.attaches: Rides the root joint body; its neck end butts the head part at mount neck [0, 0.56, 0.14]; its underside meets the legs at mount hipCenter; the tail fan starts at joint tailBase.

parts.builds: Two folded wings, one per side, each an assembly of stacked flat geometric slabs hugging the flank and sweeping slightly down-back. The base layer is a bauhausBlue half-disc extrude (about 3 cm thick, 0.26 long, 0.2 tall) laid along the body side from the shoulder back toward the tail. Over its lower rear half sits a bauhausRed crescent layer, slightly smaller and inset, and at the wingtip a small ink-black triangle wedge caps the point. Each wing gets one thin cream arc trim (a narrow curved band piece) along its top edge where it meets the body. The wings sit symmetric at mounts shoulderL and shoulderR, angled so their outer edges stay just outside the torso silhouette, and ride joints wingL and wingR so they can be posed open later.
parts.attaches: Roots at mounts shoulderL [0.14, 0.47, 0.04] and shoulderR [-0.14, 0.47, 0.04] on the body sides (joints wingL, wingR); inner edges sit flush against the body part's flank surface.

parts.builds: The head is a bauhausBlue sphere, radius about 0.115, centred at the neck mount and pushed slightly forward so it reads as a ball on the egg body. The face is settled first: two big round eye discs, one per side-front, each a flat ink-black disc (radius 0.045) seated on the sphere surface with a smaller white highlight dot disc offset up-forward, wide-set and clearly visible from the front. The beak is a single bauhausYellow triangular cone (low-poly, 4-sided frustum to a point) about 0.09 long pointing straight forward (+Z) at beak height between and just below the eyes, with a thin ink-black band ring at its base where it meets the head. Around the neck where head meets body sits a bauhausRed collar ring (a short fat cylinder or torus) separating blue head from red body. On top of the head a small crest: three flat bauhausYellow semicircle fins in a row along the skull's crown, each a thin extruded half-disc standing up like a mohawk of geometric petals, edged in ink. Everything is a hard-edged primitive in a flat palette colour.
parts.attaches: Sits on the body at mount neck [0, 0.56, 0.14], riding joint head; the collar ring overlaps the body's neck end so the two parts meet with no gap.
